task.user_request_original:
Execute a deterministic Transfer Matrix Method optimization for a planar three-medium stack: Air (n=1.0), Layer 1 (SiO2 (Gao), n=1.46, lossless), Layer 2 (TiO2 (Siefke), n=2.40, lossless), Substrate (Glass, n=1.52, lossless). The stack order is fixed as Air/SiO2 (Gao)/TiO2 (Siefke)/Glass. Optimize the thickness of Layer 1 and Layer 2 independently, with both constrained to the range [40, 160] nm. The objective is to minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance for s-polarized light at normal incidence (0 degrees) over the wavelength range 450 nm to 700 nm, sampled at 5 nm intervals. Use seed 17 for the optimizer. Perform up to 64 solver evaluations. Report the best candidate's thicknesses, the full reflectance spectrum, and the calculated mean reflectance.

Immutable original user request (overrides conflicting route proposals):
Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (constant refractive index 1.52, lossless), with air incidence (index 1.0). Use only lossless constant-index SiO2 (n=1.46) and TiO2 (n=2.40), one layer of each in either order. Each layer thickness must be between 40 and 160 nm. At normal incidence with s polarization, minimize the arithmetic mean power reflectance sampled from 450 to 700 nm at 5 nm spacing. A mean reflectance below 0.03 is the stated target. Use deterministic TMM only, with no RCWA, FDFD, learned surrogate or hardware. Allow at most two executed research rounds with one route and at most 64 solver evaluations per round, seed 17. After observing the actual result, choose a justified adjustment or stop. Do not claim the target was met without the spectrum and independent numeric check.
Preserve its physical constraints. Performance targets remain soft objectives.
